name: query
description: Search forwarded CyberArk component logs (newest first) for one environment. Use exact error codes in 'contains'. For DR replication use component padr in onprem.

environment.description: Target environment: pc-preprod (Privilege Cloud pre-prod), pc-prod (Privilege Cloud prod), onprem (self-hosted PAM, Primary/DR Vault)

contains.description: Text or error code to match, e.g. CACPM410E
